meta.summary: SpatialData 0.8.0 Python runtime, upstream peek CLI, official IO/plot extensions, and browser-accessible napari-spatialdata GUI for multimodal spatial omics data.
meta.description: SpatialData 0.8.0 Python runtime, upstream peek CLI, official IO/plot extensions, and browser-accessible napari-spatialdata GUI for multimodal spatial omics data.

test: python -m pip check && python /opt/spatialdata/share/testdata/spatialdata_smoke.py identity | grep -Fx 'spatialdata=0.8.0' >/dev/null && python -m spatialdata --help 2>&1 | grep -F 'Peek inside the SpatialData .zarr dataset' >/dev/null && spatialdata-gui --help | grep -F 'open SpatialData with napari through noVNC' >/dev/null && grep -Fx 'wheel_sha256=75139b0df0e27c4573141a8dbe6b3301b47231571505926ad6a633c046ec1010' /opt/spatialdata/share/doc/spatialdata/SOURCE >/dev/null && grep -Fx 'napari_spatialdata_wheel_sha256=34b6c746e08039ee2a1ead3b30e6dbfa9af16288730122caa174b303ee4a5304' /opt/spatialdata/share/doc/spatialdata/SOURCE >/dev/null && grep -Fx 'websockify_wheel_sha256=ac497a8dafc7f51d28ca989f01cdf5f8add663a497d425a56b159dcb8d6a314c' /opt/spatialdata/share/doc/spatialdata/SOURCE >/dev/null && grep -Fx 'constraints_sha256=ec6c49fd094d940d2b68c44690b89cdb5b3d918d4868d99c6178893a5f2726c8' /opt/spatialdata/share/doc/spatialdata/SOURCE >/dev/null

tmp=/tmp/taf-spatialdata-roundtrip-$$; rm -rf "$tmp"; mkdir -p "$tmp"; python /opt/spatialdata/share/testdata/spatialdata_smoke.py roundtrip "$tmp/data.zarr" && test -s "$tmp/roundtrip.json" && grep -F '"spatialdata": "0.8.0"' "$tmp/roundtrip.json" >/dev/null && grep -E '"(images|labels|points|shapes|tables)": [1-9]' "$tmp/roundtrip.json" >/dev/null && rm -rf "$tmp"

tmp=/tmp/taf-spatialdata-cli-$$; rm -rf "$tmp"; mkdir -p "$tmp"; python /opt/spatialdata/share/testdata/spatialdata_smoke.py fixture "$tmp/data.zarr" && python -m spatialdata peek "$tmp/data.zarr" images labels points shapes table > "$tmp/peek.txt" && grep -F 'SpatialData object' "$tmp/peek.txt" >/dev/null && grep -F 'Images' "$tmp/peek.txt" >/dev/null && grep -F 'Tables' "$tmp/peek.txt" >/dev/null && rm -rf "$tmp"

tmp=/tmp/taf-spatialdata-operations-$$; rm -rf "$tmp"; mkdir -p "$tmp"; python /opt/spatialdata/share/testdata/spatialdata_smoke.py operations "$tmp/operations.json" && test -s "$tmp/operations.json" && grep -F '"raster_shape": [1, 16, 16]' "$tmp/operations.json" >/dev/null && grep -F '"spatialdata": "0.8.0"' "$tmp/operations.json" >/dev/null && rm -rf "$tmp"

tmp=/tmp/taf-spatialdata-gui-export-$$; rm -rf "$tmp"; mkdir -p "$tmp"; xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1024x768x24' python /opt/spatialdata/share/testdata/spatialdata_smoke.py gui-export "$tmp/gui.png" && test -s "$tmp/gui.png" && test "$(wc -c < "$tmp/gui.png")" -gt 10000 && rm -rf "$tmp"
